THE GENERAL FUND APPROPRIATIONS SUMMARY & CLASSIFICATION OF ACCOUNTS, FISCAL YEAR 2016, pages 25-30 of the FY2016 annual town report. PROGRAM NAME | APPROPRIATED FORWARD | TOTAL FUNDS AVAILABLE | TOTAL EXPENDED | TOTAL ENCUMBERED | BALANCE TO REVENUE. WHAT CLOSES. TOTAL ENCUMBERED sums to the printed GRAND TOTAL $637,981.43 TO THE CENT over the 79 unit rows. Every unit's membership was resolved by the PAGE'S OWN ARITHMETIC rather than by eye: a subtotal row claims the shortest run of preceding rows that sums to it in every column it prints, and it refused on no page. Total Insurance $1,919,998.72 foots its five members exactly; the unlabelled STATE & COUNTY ASSESSMENTS subtotal $1,303,195.00 foots its eight printed members exactly. COVERAGE: every money token the text layer holds on each page is placed in a column -- 171/171, 118/118, 123/123, 98/98, 123/123, 102/102 for pages 25-30. FY2016 IS BORN-DIGITAL: pdfplumber returns 99-628 words on every page of this run and the pages carry no embedded image, so no recognition was used and none should be. THREE ROWS ARE IN THE FILE AND ARE NOT DRAWN. Page 28 carries a `Town Barn Maintenance` group (Other Expenses $1,503.62, subtotal $1,503.62/$1,503.62/$1,503.62/$0.00) and the Vehicle Maintenance subtotal ($141,026.85/$141,026.85/$128,185.55/$430.37/$12,410.93); page 30 carries `County Retirement Assessment $967,652.00` at top=345.53, overprinted on the `STATE & COUNTY ASSESSMENTS` heading at top=342.92 (Arial,Bold 8.2 against Arial,BoldItalic 8.5). render_pdf_page.swift draws NONE of the three. The two page-28 rows are required by the GRAND TOTAL -- including them takes the BALANCE TO REVENUE residual from -$15,248.01 to -$2,837.08, and only then does the residual satisfy the page's own row identity -- so they are transcribed. County Retirement is EXCLUDED from the printed $1,303,195.00 subtotal (the eight drawn rows foot it exactly) and whether the GRAND TOTAL includes it is NOT ESTABLISHED; it is transcribed as a unit and this is said here so nobody reads it as settled. WHAT IS ATTESTED, AND WHY IT IS THE TOWN'S. Four columns do not reach the printed GRAND TOTAL, and the shortfall is ONE missing unit, not a reading: TOTAL FUNDS AVAILABLE is short $3,757,764.38 (after the Veteran's Benefits typo below), TOTAL EXPENDED short $3,754,927.30, TOTAL ENCUMBERED short $0.00 and BALANCE TO REVENUE short $2,837.08 -- and 3,757,764.38 - 3,754,927.30 - 0.00 = 2,837.08 EXACTLY, which is the identity the page states about every one of its rows. A misreading cannot satisfy that. WHAT THE SCHEDULE OMITS: it prints Interest Serial Loans, Interest Temporary Loans and Loan Administrative Fees and NO PRINCIPAL ROW. The FY16 OMNIBUS BUDGET printed in the same report, page 174, line 1, prints `Principal-Loans $2,876,260.00`, and the FY2017 report's schedule prints a `DEBT AND INTEREST` section whose first leaf is `Principal Serial Loans $3,097,672.00`. WHAT THIS DOES NOT SHOW: that the omitted unit IS the principal line, or that it is a single line. $2,876,260.00 is the VOTED figure and $3,757,764.38 is what the GRAND TOTAL requires; nothing here reconciles the two, and the omitted row's label is not printed anywhere in the document. A SECOND TOWN ERROR, page 29: `Veteran's Benefits` prints APPROPRIATED FORWARD $100,000.00 and TOTAL FUNDS AVAILABLE $1,000,000.00 -- an extra zero. Its own row closes on the smaller figure: expended $85,368.80 + balance $14,631.20 = $100,000.00. Both figures are read off the born-digital text layer and confirmed on the 4x render, so neither is a misread. The $1,000,000.00 is transcribed as printed and the row is attested. THE fwd LEGEND DOES NOT CLOSE EITHER: page 30 prints `fwd - forward from FY 2015 $265,386.55` and the 15 fwd lines the run prints sum to $259,894.72, out by $5,491.83. Registered, not reconciled.

rows.reconciliation: page 35, the row `GRAND TOTAL`: carried 3,173,622.7 vs printed 3,173,622.7 ; disbursements 6,074,216.03 vs printed 6,074,216.03 ; forward 2,704,480.72 vs printed 2,704,480.72 ; receipts 6,543,358.01 vs printed 6,543,358.01
rows.read_by: claude-opus-5 reading the page's own TEXT LAYER with pdfplumber (no recognition): each page's money tokens are matched as `(?$n,nnn.nn)?`, their printed RIGHT EDGES clustered on THAT page, and every figure placed under the column whose cluster it falls in, so a fund that prints nothing in a column keeps that column ABSENT rather than shifting the next figure left. THE RULER IS MEASURED PER PAGE AND THE PAGES DISAGREE: the four right edges are 335.9/410.2/495.8/570.1 on p31, 334.7/408.2/492.8/566.2 on p32, 335.8/409.5/494.4/568.1 on p33, 336.1/410.0/494.9/568.7 on p34 and 336.6/410.8/496.1/570.3 on p35 -- reading one page with another page's ruler throws figures into the wrong column.
rows.proof: SPECIAL REVENUE FUNDS, FISCAL YEAR ENDING 6/30/16 -- the schedule the FY2016 annual town report prints across PDF pages 31, 33, 34 and 35. PROGRAM NAME | FORWARD 7/1/2015 | TOTAL RECEIPTS | TOTAL DISBURSEMENTS | BALANCE FWD 7/1/2016. 130 funds. ALL FOUR COLUMNS TIE TO THE CENT to the GRAND TOTAL the schedule prints on page 35: $2,704,480.72 / $6,543,358.01 / $6,074,216.03 / $3,173,622.70. AND PAGE 32 IS NOT IN THIS GROUP, DELIBERATELY: the report prints an extra, un-headed page between 31 and 33 that reprints 26 of page 33's funds and the first fund of page 34, figure for figure in all four columns. Including it puts the forward column $3,211.41 over the printed GRAND TOTAL; excluding it ties all four exactly, and excluding page 33 instead does NOT tie (short $1.97, the `Community Policing FY 97` row page 34 also carries). That is what establishes which printing the town counted. The reprint is read and published separately in `fy2016-p32-special-revenue-reprint.csv`. THE ROW IDENTITY THE SCHEDULE STATES -- forward + receipts - disbursements = balance carried forward -- HOLDS ON ALL 157 ROWS OF ALL FIVE PAGES, including the 27 reprinted ones, computed at read time. IT IS NOT DECLARED HERE BECAUSE verify_page_reads.py CANNOT EXPRESS IT: its grammar takes `a,b,c=d` (all added) or `a-b-c=d` (all subtracted after the first) and this identity is MIXED. Written `forward,receipts-disbursements=carried` the parser looks for a column literally named `forward,receipts`, finds none, and asserts `-disbursements = carried`, which fails on every row; storing disbursements negated would make it pass and would publish a figure the page does not print. So the group is proved on the printed GRAND TOTAL, which is the stronger half, and the row identity is recorded here as computed rather than asserted.

rows.proof: FY2016 PDF PAGE 32 IS A DUPLICATE REPRINT, AND THIS FILE IS WHAT PROVES IT. The page carries no heading of any kind -- no TOWN OF LUNENBURG, no SPECIAL REVENUE FUNDS, no column headers, no section label -- and prints 27 funds at a wider row pitch (24.9pt against 22.3pt on page 33). Every one of the 84 figures it prints is printed again inside the schedule the town's own GRAND TOTAL counts: 26 of the funds on page 33, and `Community Policing FY 97` on page 34. `fund_number` names the page of the second printing for every figure. THE CHECK: `p32 = in_schedule`, 84 independent assertions, every one between two figures read off two printed pages and neither derived. WHAT SETTLES WHICH PRINTING THE TOWN COUNTED, and it is arithmetic rather than appearance: the 130 funds of pages 31, 33, 34 and 35 tie to the printed GRAND TOTAL to the cent in all four columns; adding page 32 puts forward $3,211.41 and carried $439,977.92 over it; and substituting page 32 for page 33 leaves forward and carried $1.97 SHORT, because page 32 also carries page 34's first fund. WHY THE PAGE WAS UNPROVEN: `special-revenue-read.csv` holds all 130 counted funds for FY2016 and ties 4 of 4, but its `page` column attributes page 33's content to 33 while nothing is attributed to 32, so a tracker joining on page number sees page 32 as unread. The page was never missing data; it is a page the schedule does not count. WHAT THIS DOES NOT SHOW: why the duplicate was printed. A page assembled twice, a late correction, and a printing error all fit this evidence equally, and nothing in the report says which. The figures are published as printed and nothing is corrected.
